## Developer Journey

### Beginner Path
Start your journey by setting up your local environment and executing your first transaction. Learn the fundamentals of Rayls infrastructure and get comfortable with basic operations.

**Time to complete:** ~30 minutes

### Intermediate Path
Once you're familiar with the basics, dive into smart contract development. Learn to deploy and interact with ERC-20, ERC-721, and ERC-1155 tokens on Privacy Node Ledgers.

**Time to complete:** ~2-4 hours

### Advanced Path
Master privacy-preserving technologies with Rayls Enygma, implement zero-knowledge atomic swaps, and verify resilience under failure with fault injection. Build production-grade applications with full privacy guarantees.

**Time to complete:** ~8-12 hours

### Reference Materials
Access comprehensive documentation on CLI tools, testing frameworks, migration guides, and development best practices to support your entire development lifecycle.

## What Can You Build?

### Token Issuance and Management
- Deploy private stablecoins (USDC, USDT)
- Issue security tokens with compliance rules
- Create tokenized assets (real estate, bonds)
- Build multi-currency payment systems

### Cross-Chain Applications
- Inter-institution settlement systems
- Atomic cross-chain swaps (DvP)
- Multi-party escrow services
- Batch transaction processing

### Privacy-Preserving Solutions
- Confidential payments with Rayls Enygma
- Private atomic swaps with ZK-DVP
- Anonymous asset transfers
- Privacy-compliant AML systems

### Enterprise Integration
- Connect to existing custody solutions
- Integrate with treasury management systems
- Build compliance and audit dashboards
- Develop regulatory reporting tools
